content.short: Steer Protocol runs automated liquidity vaults and policy tools across 40+ chains.
content.description: Steer Protocol automates liquidity management for concentrated positions, running vaults and rebalancing engines for over a thousand tokens across more than forty chains including Hyperliquid and Robinhood Chain. Projects typically use it so their own token's liquidity is managed systematically rather than depending on whoever happens to be providing it that week.
